# IR parser symbol fixtures

`R.symbol.txt` and `C.symbol.txt` are complete individual symbol expressions
provided by the project author from KiCad 9.0.6's `Device.kicad_sym` library.
They are retained as regression inputs for the general-purpose S-expression IR.
They are not a complete `.kicad_sym` library file and do not test inheritance or
all supported symbol-library features.
